U.pool_policy: Source review: non-index planning uses SessionContext::new and execute uses TaskContext::default, both with unbounded pools. LANCE_MEM_POOL_SIZE is configured but is not the execution pool limit.

B.pool_policy: Source review: planning and execution obtain separate bounded contexts from the spilling-enabled factory; the factory does not cache that context. The configured limit is not one shared combined peak.

P.pool_policy: Source review: execute shares one bounded planning/execution context. analyze_plan uses another fresh bounded execution context. Scan sizing uses whole-table physical mean width.

D.pool_policy: Source review: planning and execute/analyze share the bounded factory context; deferred payload is not itself a hard total-RSS budget.

CTX.pool_policy: Source review: planning and execution share the bounded factory context, without deferred payload or a new join selector.

DB.pool_policy: Source review: planning and execute/analyze share the bounded factory context; B join selection is combined with deferred payload.

DP.pool_policy: Source review: P MergeBudget shares the bounded execute context; D shares the analyze context. Scan sizing remains based on whole-table physical mean width despite a narrow projection.
